instruction: Put the red cube on the orange zone.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
red_cube = obs["objects"]["red_cube"]
orange_zone = obs["zones"]["orange_zone"]

# Move to above the red_cube
go_to(red_cube["center"][0], red_cube["center"][1], red_cube["top_z"] + 0.1)

# Pick up the red_cube
pick("red_cube", 0.02, red_cube["long_axis_yaw"])

# Move to above the orange_zone
go_to(orange_zone["center"][0], orange_zone["center"][1], orange_zone["center"][2] + 0.1)

# Place the red_cube on the orange_zone
place("orange_zone")
